SOLAR TRACKING PROJECT


1. Introduction


1.1 Overview


As a passionate advocate for clean energy, I embarked on a personal project to create a DIY Solar Tracking System. This system is designed to ensure my solar PV setup operates highest efficiently, making sure the solar panel is pependicular to the direction of the sun.


2. System Components


2.1 ESP32 DevKit


The microcontroller serves as the central processing unit, gathering data from sensors, performing calculations, and controlling the servo motors.


2.2 MG995 Servo Motor


The MG995 Servo Motor will rotate the solar panel to its desired direction. One for azimuth axis and the other is for elevation (or tilt) axis


2.3 Light-dependent Resistor


Light-dependent resistor is very sensitive to light. Its resistance will become high when there is low light and will decreases when light is introduced. This is important as the change in resistance will be read by the ESP32 to decide where is the direction of light source.


2.4 10k Ohm Resistor


This is used to create voltage divider to measure the voltage of the Light-Dependet resistor.


2.5 10k Ohm Variable Resistor


This component is used to control the speed of the motor. It will be placed in series with the servo motor.

6. Software and Libraries

Highlight code with copy button 
                          
                            #include <ESP32Servo.h>


                              Servo horizontal; // horizontal servo
                              int servoh = 180; 
                              int servohLimitHigh = 175;
                              int servohLimitLow = 5;
                              // 65 degrees MAX
                              
                              Servo vertical; // vertical servo
                              int servov = 45; 
                              int servovLimitHigh = 60;
                              int servovLimitLow = 1;
                              
                              // LDR pin connections
                              // name = analogpin;
                              int ldrlt = 26; //LDR top left - BOTTOM LEFT <--- BDG
                              int ldrrt = 25; //LDR top rigt - BOTTOM RIGHT
                              int ldrld = 33; //LDR down left - TOP LEFT
                              int ldrrd = 32; //ldr down rigt - TOP RIGHT
                              
                              void setup(){
                              horizontal.attach(9);
                              vertical.attach(10);
                              horizontal.write(180);
                              vertical.write(45);
                              delay(2500);
                              }
                              void loop() {
                              int lt = analogRead(ldrlt); // top left
                              int rt = analogRead(ldrrt); // top right
                              int ld = analogRead(ldrld); // down left
                              int rd = analogRead(ldrrd); // down right
                              int dtime = 10; int tol = 90; // dtime=diffirence time, tol=toleransi
                              int avt = (lt + rt) / 2; // average value top
                              int avd = (ld + rd) / 2; // average value down
                              int avl = (lt + ld) / 2; // average value left
                              int avr = (rt + rd) / 2; // average value right
                              int dvert = avt - avd; // check the diffirence of up and down
                              int dhoriz = avl - avr;// check the diffirence og left and rigt
                              
                              if (-1*tol > dvert || dvert > tol) 
                               {
                               if (avt > avd)
                               {
                               servov = ++servov;
                               if (servov > servovLimitHigh)
                               {servov = servovLimitHigh;}
                               }
                               else if (avt < avd)
                               {servov= --servov;
                               if (servov < servovLimitLow)
                               { servov = servovLimitLow;}
                               }
                               vertical.write(servov);
                               }
                              if (-1*tol > dhoriz || dhoriz > tol) // check if the diffirence is in the tolerance else change horizontal angle
                               {
                               if (avl > avr)
                               {
                               servoh = --servoh;
                               if (servoh < servohLimitLow)
                               {
                               servoh = servohLimitLow;
                               }
                               }
                               else if (avl < avr)
                               {
                               servoh = ++servoh;
                               if (servoh > servohLimitHigh)
                               {
                               servoh = servohLimitHigh;
                               }
                               }
                               else if (avl = avr)
                               {
                               delay(5000);
                               }
                               horizontal.write(servoh);
                               }
                               
                               delay(dtime);
                               
                              }
